mean: to trick someone into letting the truth slip
lit: to hook someone with a sickle

use.how: Said of a question or remark, often pretending to know already, meant to make someone reveal what they hide: 鎌をかけたら白状した. Passive: 鎌をかけられる.

near.diff: 探りを入れる is any careful probing for information; 鎌をかける uses a trick, such as pretending to know, so the person slips.

cue: To find out whether your sister skipped school, you casually say a neighbour saw her at the mall. She confesses at once.
